scope: EU/EEA fully automated vehicles covered by the type-approval framework
access: Reported to authorities; no public incident-level feed identified
notes: Manufacturers must notify safety-critical occurrences and provide short-term and annual in-service occurrence reporting to type-approval/market-surveillance authorities and the European Commission.

scope: EU road crashes involving death or injury
access: European Commission road-safety database; detailed national crash records
notes: Potential backstop for injury/fatal crashes, but the standard public CARE description does not identify ADS engagement, so matching would require country/date/location/vehicle information.

source: National crash databases and transport authorities
scope: Member-state police/hospital crash records and AV trial permits
access: Varies by country; some datasets require access requests
notes: Example: Sweden's STRADA combines police and hospital injury-crash information. National transport/type-approval agencies may also hold ADS occurrence reports that are not centrally published.
Current beta source. Multiple articles about one crash are merged into one canonical incident. Operator and public-agency statements are preferred when available.
